thread:
maya: Follow-up from RFC: deciding on an approach for prefetching telemetry across shards. We prototyped 2 extremes (fully per-shard vs centralized prefetcher). Need a pragmatic plan that minimizes memory blowup but keeps ordering guarantees and immediate cost attribution.

jorge: quick summary of tradeoffs: per-shard = simple, predictable ordering, but memory ~ O(active_tenants_per_shard). central = lower mem, higher coordination/CPU and harder ordering.

eli: proposal: asymmetric hybrid. Keep tiny per-tenant hot buffers on the shard for N hottest tenants; route long tail to a centralized longtail pool. Hotness determined by EMA over 30s. This reduces duplication for the long tail while keeping low-latency for hotspots.

maya: important: billing_key must be attached before batching so downstream cost dashboards are correct. recommend resolving billing_key at gateway and caching it there.

nora: agree on gateway attach. Also: when migrating a tenant between hot->longtail or vice-versa, we must avoid double-emitting. Use durable cursor storage with CAS to record last-emitted cursor and let new owner resume from that cursor.

jorge: edge case: tenant with high stream-cardinality (fanout) will still stress hot buffers. Add rule: if unique_stream_keys > 800 in last 1m, mark tenant for dedicated-prefetch pool. That avoids noisy neighbor problems.

eli: metrics & traces to add: prefetch.strategy={per-shard,central,hybrid}, prefetch.hot_promotions, prefetch.hot_demotions, prefetch.migration_count, prefetch.rehydrate_failures, prefetch.buffer_bytes. Add trace attributes billing_key and prefetch.owner_node.

maya: canary plan: enable hybrid in staging, then 2% of prod traffic (prefer mid-sized tenants). Observe migration rate, buffer mem, prefetch.latency, and billing attribution errors for 72h before expanding. Add alarm if migration_rate > 5/min or rehydrate_failures > 1/hr.

jorge: config snippet draft:
```yaml
prefetch:
  mode: hybrid
  hot_window_sec: 30
  hot_top_k_per_shard: 120
  per_tenant_hot_bytes: 131072
  longtail_pool_bytes: 1572864
  fanout_unique_keys_threshold: 800
  billing_key_cache_ttl_sec: 300
```

nora: action items:
- jorge: update gateway to attach billing_key + cache metrics (due Thu)
- eli: durable cursor CAS contract + rehydrate flow doc (due Wed)
- maya: canary playbook + alert thresholds (due Fri)
